profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company that describes itself as pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility worldwide. It says it was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and now operates three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). Its core technology is what it calls a "virtual driver," and the company says it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations.

According to its site, Pony.ai's autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and the company says it has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. It describes itself as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving and says it aims to deliver autonomous driving systems at scale.

The company is a public company traded under the ticker PONY, with a headquarters listed in Guangzhou. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
